title: The Ashwood has several transit-only rooms (Camp Smoke, Broken Bridge, Ashfall Clearing, Tower Shadow, Crow Perch, Herb Hollow, Last Trees) that cost a turn each with little payoff; either trim them or let 'travel to a known place' shortcut through them sooner so exploration doesn't eat the whole turn budget.
